pages.text: $(#FFD700)👑 Immortal Sovereignty · Divine Body Tempering 💫$()$(br2)$(l)$(#D4AF37)「Those who drink this divine blood shall find their flesh a sacred temple, and fire transformed into cleansing dew」$()$(br)When the $(#FF8C00)Eternal Golden Apple$()’s immortality, the $(#5F9EA0)Sacred Ice Lotus$()’s crystal essence, the $(#DAA520)Sunlit Honeydew$()’s fiery brilliance, and the $(#D4AF37)Gold Ingot$() achieve $(l)Trinity Perfection$() in the $(#8B4513)Eternal Furnace$()—this stands as the $(l)apex of alchemical mastery$().

$(#D4AF37)▌ Sacred Trinity $()$(br2)$(l)$(#FF4500)🔥 Dragon’s Breath Immunity$()$(br)Skin forms $(#8B0000)molten markings$(), absorbing fire elements.$(br2)$(l)$(#FF69B4)💖 Heart of the Immortal$()$(br)With every heartbeat, $(#FF1493)pink-gold particles$() pulse outward.$(br2)$(l)$(#8B4513)🛡 Orichalcum Matrix$()$(br)Damage is deflected by a $(#D4AF37)golden force field$() before contact.

$(br2)$(#B8860B)▌ Divine Forging Process $()$(br)- Use a $(#D4AF37)Golden Blade$() to extract the $(#FF8C00)Gold Core Seeds$() from the $(#FFD700)Golden Apple$().$(br)- Dry the $(#5F9EA0)Ice Lotus$() under $(#87CEEB)cold sunlight$() until $(#E6E6FA)crystal veins$() appear.$(br)- $(#DAA520)Honey$() must be purified through $(#FF4500)seven layers of fire refinement$() to become $(#D4AF37)Liquid Sun$().$(br)- During fusion, add the $(#D4AF37)Gold Ingot$() in a $(#32CD32)mysterious spiral pattern$().$(br2)$(#FF0000)⚡$() The divine infusion is complete when $(#FFD700)sun halo radiance$() appears and $(#8B4513)tiger-stripe crystallization$() emerges.

$(br2)$(#8B4513)『 Hermes Manuscript 』$()$(br)Emerald Tablet Column 17 Inscription:$(br)'This $(#D4AF37)Divine Drink$() unites $(#FF8C00)Immortality$(), $(#5F9EA0)Purity$(), and $(#DAA520)Fervor$(),$(br)granting the drinker $(#FF4500)Surtr’s Blessing$() and $(#FF69B4)Idunn’s Youth$()—$(br)while $(#8B4513)Odin’s Golden Barrier$() shall forever shield them$(br)from the $(#000000)Ragnarök$() and its $(#FF0000)apocalyptic flames$().'
